name: Develop
description: Multi-agent development pipeline: Planner dispatches Dev + Tests in parallel, Docs documents the result, QA merges and opens a draft pull/merge request. Triggered when a ticket enters the "Dev" board column (rename the trigger filter to match your board's column or label names).

workflows.name: Develop
workflows.description: Polling on status=Dev. Planner reads the ticket and dispatches scoped work to Dev and Tests (parallel branched worktrees). Docs runs once both finish so it documents what was actually shipped. QA consumes the merged workspace and opens a draft pull/merge request.

nodes.name: Planner
nodes.instructionsAppend: Convention for this workflow: Dev owns production code only, Tests owns test files only. (Docs and QA run after the parallel group and are not part of your dispatch.)

nodes.name: Dev
nodes.instructionsAppend: Sibling agent Tests runs in parallel — do not touch test files. Docs runs after you finish — do not touch user-facing documentation. Focus only on production code.

nodes.name: Docs
nodes.instructionsAppend: Your workspace already contains the merged output of Dev and Tests. Document only what was actually implemented — read the diff and `.conduit/` summaries from upstream agents before writing.

nodes.name: QA
nodes.instructionsAppend: After opening the draft pull/merge request, move the ticket to the review-stage column or label on the board (named "Review" by default).
